name: KromiumEngineDownloadSource
summary: Defines the strategy for acquiring the JCEF engine binaries.

subclasses.name: KromiumEngineDownloadSource.Manual
subclasses.description: Do not attempt to download the engine. Binaries must be placed manually.

subclasses.name: KromiumEngineDownloadSource.DirectUrl
subclasses.description: Download the engine from a direct URL resolved dynamically based on current platform.

subclasses.name: KromiumEngineDownloadSource.GitHubRelease
subclasses.description: Resolve and download the engine from a GitHub Release API endpoint.

companionMethods.name: directUrl
companionMethods.signature: fun directUrl(bundleUrl: String, checksumUrl: String? = null): KromiumEngineDownloadSource
companionMethods.description: Uses a static, hardcoded URL regardless of the platform.

companionMethods.name: directUrl
companionMethods.signature: fun directUrl(bundleResolver: KromiumPlatformUrlResolver, checksumResolver: KromiumPlatformUrlResolver? = null): KromiumEngineDownloadSource
companionMethods.description: Uses a dynamic resolver function to determine the URL based on OS and architecture.

parameters.name: checksumResolver
parameters.description: Optional platform resolver for checksum URL.

companionMethods.name: githubRelease
companionMethods.signature: fun githubRelease(repoOwner: String = "JetBrains", repoName: String = "JetBrainsRuntime", releaseTag: String? = null, apiBaseUrl: String = "https://api.github.com"): KromiumEngineDownloadSource
companionMethods.description: Resolves engine release assets from GitHub Releases API.

parameters.name: releaseTag
parameters.description: Specific release tag or null for latest.
